verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect support for scripted, non-GUI use. Community users describe built-in command-line tools they chain in pipelines (pbcopy/pbpaste, networkQuality, fs_usage, stapler), and one user logged into a Mac remotely via Remote Management. Shortcuts automation is mentioned in the docs, but nothing shows unattended headless operation or CI integration. Missing for 10: documented headless/unattended operation, CI runner or pipeline support, first-party automation docs for non-interactive use, independent hands-on CI corroboration.
